text:
[IRET.10.2] **Logical emit.** Same as plain emit but
registers the asserted fact's ID in the TMS dependency
table under the current activation's ID.

idris.name: iret_10_2__record
idris.note: A logical emit registers the asserted fact's id under the current activation; an explicit emit registers nothing.

idris.name: iret_10_2__record_rows_emitted
idris.note: The clause's record: a row only for a logical emit, targeting the fact of that kind found live afterwards, so every row targets an emitted kind of the recording rule.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__emits_of
idris.note: The kinds a rule's logical emits can record rows for: an emit's kind. A withdraw records nothing.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__rows_emitted_record
idris.note: The clause's row, recorded for the fact the emit left live, targets a fact of the emit's kind; with unique ids, the only fact carrying the id.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_tms_frame
idris.note: The row the clause records for a logical emit targets an emitted kind of the firing rule, which a framed chain does not read; so the cascade the row's ending will start skips the chain.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__fired_row
idris.note: The row the clause's record left: one, targeting the kind-2 fact. Computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__fired_trace
idris.note: B's logical emit inside the run records a row for the fact it left live; the trace shows the fact live after it. Executed.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__do_action_tms_agree
idris.note: A logical emit registers the same row on both sides: the record reads the working memory and the lifecycle, which agree.

idris.name: iret_10_2__record_elem
idris.note: A row of the table after a record is an old row or the recorded one, whose target is a live fact of the emitted kind.
